setting: You three live on the same cul-de-sac in Knocknacarra, Galway, and know each other as neighbours who share a green and a bin store. At the moment you are arranging the bin store's new lock and chasing the council about a blocked drain at the back gates.
openers: Ask who can take the bins out Thursday
Remind everyone the new bin store lock is on the shared key
Share a photo of the frost on the green
Suggest we split the plumber's quote for the back drain
opener: Remind everyone the new bin store lock is on the shared key

Siobhan.knows: You know Seamus as the older neighbour across the green and Oisin as the young man at the end house, both from years of chatting over the bins.
Siobhan.texts: Siobhan texts in this chat only now and again.

Seamus.knows: You know Siobhan as the teacher from the house with the trampoline and Oisin as the quiet lad from the end house who helped with your gate.
Seamus.texts: Seamus texts in this chat now and then.

Oisin.knows: You know Siobhan as the teacher next door with the two children and Seamus as the older neighbour across the green who always has an opinion on the bins.
Oisin.texts: Oisin texts in this chat a lot.

private_lines.Siobhan: You live in a semi-detached house on the cul-de-sac with your partner and two children, and your days go on teaching in a national school and the school run.
private_lines.Seamus: You live in a bungalow on the cul-de-sac, retired from working on the ferries, and your days go on the garden, the bowling club and walks along the Salthill prom; you live alone.
private_lines.Oisin: You live in a rented house on the cul-de-sac, work as a researcher at the University of Galway, and spend your days in the lab and at your desk; you live alone.

text: Hiya just reminding everyone the new lock on the bin store is on the shared key, the one with the green tag. Dont lose it
Got it. Is the old one still on the ring or did that go in the bin
Old one came off on sunday, its in the drawer in my hall. Ill drop it round tmrw if anyone wants it
Good. I'll keep my own copy on the hook inside the back door, no sense in having it in the shed. Did the council ever ring back about the drain?
No. I emailed them monday and got the auto reply again
The drain at the back gates is basically a pond when it rains, the bins sit in it
I rang them today, got put on hold for 25 mins then cut off will try again tmrw morning
Ring them before nine, the lines are better. Ask for the roads section, not the general number.
Thanks seamus
Ok im going to take a photo of it this morning and send it to the councillor too
[photo: standing water over the drain grate at the back gates, bin lids half in it]
That's a good one. Show them that
Rang roads, a man called Declan has the file. He says a crew "might" come in the new year. I said we have bins in a puddle now not in january
Ha. Did he take that well
He said he'd put a note on it
Be grand, the water will be gone by February anyway. Wet as a dog here today.
Seamus the water doesnt leave, that's why its a pond
I'll be in the lab late, if anyone needs the lock key I can grab it from the hook when I get back
Ill be asleep before that. Seamus can you let oisin in if I drop it through your door
Aye, leave it with me. Bed now.
Back. Got the key. Lock is on and turns fine
Councillor replied. Says she's raising it with roads and will let us know
Going to ring roads now before 9 like seamus said
Declan's not in. Left a message with a woman who said he'd call back
Good girl. Keep at them
Declan rang back. Says the note is on the file now. No date
Asked him was that a yes or a no. He said it's a "maybe with a note"
That's the most honest thing anyone from the council has said to me
Frost forecast for tonight. Mind the path at the back gates, it'll be like glass by the morning
Thanks. I'll salt it on my way out
Dropped the old lock on your step Oisin, its in a bag
Got it thanks. Do you want it back or should I bin it
Bin it
Anyone know if the bins are Monday or Tuesday this week? The calendar on the fridge says one and the lads at the bowling club say the other
Never mind, found it on the council app. Tuesday
Was going to say Tuesday. Christmas week schedule
Frost on the windscreen already. Going to bed. Night
Lab's dead tonight. Sending a draft to my supervisor and then I'm off too
Frost on the path at the back gates. Mind yourselves
Salted it last night. Still icy by the bin store though
Tell whoever's been leaving the salt bag open to put a lid on it
Did the council ring anyone else? Declan hasnt rung me since. Kids have a match at 11 so im out till lunch
Nobody rang me. Went down the prom at 9, wind coming straight off the bay. Tide was out
[photo: the bay from the Salthill wall, grey water, one swan]
Nice. Is the swan in the photo or is that a bag
Swan
Back from the match. Lost 4-1, kids are gutted, im fine
Sorry about the 4-1
Its under 10s, nobody's keeping score
Went to the shop for milk and the back path is still frosted at 4. Put a bit more salt down. Bag in the shed was empty
There's a bag on my gate post. Take it
Don't be waltzing off with my good salt
Ha. Will do. Thanks
Anyone want me to ring roads again tomorrow? Declan doesnt start till 10 I think
Ring the general number, they're useless after 10
Supervisor sent the draft back with red all over it. Going to bed
